punjab_day.cleaning: MODIS confidence >= 30, VIIRS confidence n/h, type 0 (the product's confidence and type filters)
punjab_day.source: NASA FIRMS standard processing (MCD14ML C6.1, VNP14IMGML), data/interim/firms_raw

aqua_outage.ember_note: Calember daily world total (MODIS-equivalent, from VIIRS in 2020; products/api/agg_day.parquet). Raw MODIS also counts low-confidence and static detections, so it sits about 10 % higher on normal days.
aqua_outage.unit: MODIS fire detections per day, whole planet (raw FIRMS)

sensor_day.cleaning: MODIS confidence >= 30, VIIRS n/h, type 0; whole planet, day and night
sensor_day.images: NASA Worldview snapshots of the same day (textures/*_2019-08-22.*)

globe_dive.note: daytime passes only (the afternoon images); Aqua MODIS conf >= 30, S-NPP VIIRS n/h, type 0; in_state = inside the Punjab + Haryana outline
